name: Flickering Blossom (Imperial Origin)
body:
You are from a land infused with positive energy, where the plants grow tall and shed blossoms year-round.

Imperial Training: sword cane

Overloaded Mark: While the mark is active, the target takes a penalty to saving throws against compulsion and teleportation effects equal to 1/3 your class level (minimum -1). Additionally, when the mark is expended, creature dealing damage to discharge the mark gains 1d6 + 1/2 your class level in temporary hit points. These temporary hit points do not stack with others earned by the overloaded mark and last 1 minute.

Imperial Origin Abilities
Dancing Petals (Su)

At 1st level, you can leave an explosion of petals while you escape as a standard action.

All creatures within 5 feet of your original position take 1d6 damage per 2 class levels you possess (minimum 1d6), half of which is slashing, the other half is positive energy. A successful Reflex save (DC 10 + 1/2 your class level + your Charisma modifier) halves this damage. Any creature that fails their save also cannot perform attacks of opportunity triggered by your movement for the rest of the round. This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Blooming Vitality (Su)

At 7th level, you can grant speed and vitality to an ally within 30 feet. The target’s speed is increased by 30 feet and they gain temporary hit points equal to your class level for 1 round. You can target a number of allies equal to 1/4 your class level (minimum 1). This ability is usable a number of times per day equal to your Charisma modifier.

Flickering Seal (Su)

At 14th level, as a move action you can teleport to a space adjacent to a creature bearing your empire’s mark. You must be able to see the creature to use this ability. This ability is usable at will.
